access_method: Public page reader and public GitHub API. No authenticated DrivenData account. Public content and rankings are time-sensitive. No competition files were downloaded.

observations: Prediction target is geological faults, not confirmed geothermal vents.
The competition warns that public fault labels may be incomplete or inaccurate; private scoring is followed by expert review and final rescoring against expanded labels.
Distance-weighted Tversky uses alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, and a triangular kernel with 300 m support.
Submission is one float32 GeoTIFF layer with confidence values in [0,1], EPSG:32611, 100 m resolution and the training bounds; the page says data outside the bounds are null or NaN.
The sample submission is described as predicting total fault absence.

sources.observation_type: PUBLIC ORGANIZER LEADERBOARD SNAPSHOT — NOT ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED FOR ANY LOCAL TIFF; NOT A SUBMISSION-PAGE RECEIPT
sources.limitations: The displayed public rank can change and is not a private-round result or evidence for the score of any owner-hosted TIFF. This page fetch recorded the top row only; it does not resolve other user-cited values.

sources.observation: The public reader redirected to the DrivenData login page. Training files, organizer sample bytes, account quota, and submission receipts were not accessible here.
Public reference-solution code is available at this pinned commit. It is not an authenticated copy of competition inputs and does not supply the missing organizer data or receipt.

sources.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey and Department of Energy
observations: USGS lists public GeoDAWN magnetic and radiometric grids and flight-line data for geological and geophysical mapping; the release DOI is 10.5066/P93LGLVQ.
No GeoDAWN files were downloaded in this review. Source-page availability does not authenticate owner-mirrored bands or their local provenance.

The official INGENIOUS page lists a public CC BY 4.0 compilation and links a 19.85 MB Well and Spring Temperature and Chemistry archive and an 82.04 kB Paleo Geothermal Features archive; it also lists other geophysical and well/spring resources.

The page verifies that official packages are listed for download, not that their contents, analyte completeness, spatial coverage, datum, or local hashes were inspected. No GDR archive was downloaded here.

The official page lists Landsat 8-9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance and surface temperature products at 30 m and provides an EarthExplorer access route; USGS describes its Landsat archive access as no-cost open data.
The exact GEMS-footprint scene inventory, cloud-free seasonal coverage, and usable temporal sample were not queried. No Landsat data were downloaded.

sources.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map
observations: The official National Map page provides DEM/elevation access and a LidarExplorer route for searching/downloading 3DEP lidar and DEM products.
Exact tile availability, resolution continuity, CRS, and coverage over the GEMS footprint were not queried; no DEM or lidar files were downloaded.
The official FDSN Event Web Service documents custom earthquake queries; the API documentation includes event products such as moment-tensor and focal-mechanism products.
No footprint query was run. The number, spatial distribution, quality, and time coverage of focal-mechanism observations in the GEMS area remain unverified.

release_conclusion: No candidate leaderboard estimate is supported. A public leaderboard snapshot is separate from HOLDOUT-DTI and cannot authenticate a local file; an ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED result requires a submission-page receipt bound to the exact file.
